author: TeIq
content: **Pre-flight (architect).** New polaris-backend/src/api/setup.rs. All 4 endpoints authed + require admin role. Reuse moderator's OAuth session by unsealing sessions.refresh_token_enc (SerializedSessionState bundle: dpop_keypair_jwk_json + TokenSet) per call, reconstruct OAuthSession, drive via session.post. generate-key writes K-256 to operator-configured path + records in new polaris_setup_state migration. publish-labeler-record reuses build_labeler_service_record from polaris-publish-labeler-record::lib. submit-plc reuses build_did_web_document → service+verificationMethods builders from polaris-publish-did-service::lib. Integration tests with MockFetcher mirroring tests/atproto_refresh.rs pattern.
